# Artico — Dečiji kreativni atelje (Children's Art Studio), Belgrade

> Artico is a children's creative art studio in Belgrade, Serbia, offering drawing, painting, fashion design and 3D modeling classes for kids aged 4–14. Small groups (6–10 children), personalized mentoring, first trial class free.

## Key facts

- Name: Artico — Dečiji kreativni atelje
- Location: Šolina 7A, Dedinje, Beograd (Belgrade), Serbia
- Website: https://artico.rs
- Phone: +381 69 682 184 (also Viber and WhatsApp)
- Email: artico.create@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/artico_solina
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/t5DZ9PuHYZzYac8h8
- Google reviews: https://maps.app.goo.gl/DQwtcb4iDdBH1sMV8 (leave a review: https://search.google.com/local/writereview?placeid=ChIJmcE8vZtxWkcRK25i2gXlsZs)
- Ages: 4–14 years
- Group size: 6–10 children
- Classes: 75–90 minutes, once or twice a week, monthly cycles (4–8 sessions per month)
- First (trial) class: free, no obligation
- Sibling discount: 15% for the second child from the same family
- All materials included; classes end with photos of the works, a diploma and a closing event
- Languages: Serbian (English-speaking families welcome)

## Programs

- **Artico Fashion Atelier** — fashion design program for kids: fashion illustration, fashion sketching, moodboards, a mini collection, ending with "Artico Mini Fashion Day" (a small fashion show with exhibition and certificates). Ages ~9–13.
- **Drawing and painting workshops (Kreativne radionice crtanja i slikanja)** — three progressive levels from drawing basics to independent projects and an exhibition. Ages 7–14.
- **3D workshop (3D radionica)** — the child draws a character, models it, and it gets printed on a 3D printer.
- **Mali kreativci (Little Creatives)** — program for ages 4–7: finger painting, collage, modeling, colors and textures through play.
- **Individual 1:1 classes** — flexible scheduling, tailored to the child.
- **Large canvas projects** — individual painting projects on a large canvas.
- **Corporate program** — creative workshops and monthly programs as an employee benefit for employees' children, team events and family days.

## Schedule (indicative, updated each cycle)

- Ages 4–7: by arrangement (Mali kreativci)
- Ages 7–9: Tuesday 17:30 (drawing and painting)
- Ages 10–14: Thursday 18:00 (drawing and painting)
- Ages 9–13: Saturday 11:00 (Fashion Atelier)
